training_sources: same32 train only; four balanced source-group hash folds
feature_contract: 32 features from bbox/prompt/source/text and first2 shared full steps; F final only creates offline labels
supervision: log(action_loss/R25_loss), clipped[-2,2]; R25 log score fixed zero
optimizer: AdamW lr0.01 weight_decay0.01,500 full-batch updates each; SmoothL1 beta0.2
selection: lower cross-validated source mean selected-action loss; calibration never used to choose model, epoch, threshold or hyperparameters
calibration: Cal16 after supervised and RL checkpoints both frozen; report raw policies even if fail

RL.optimizer: Adam lr0.0005; update per8 episodes;16 optimizer steps
RL.objective: REINFORCE reward=-log(loss/R25loss) clipped[-2,2], KL_to_initial weight0.05, entropy weight0.02; gradient clip1
RL.reward_source: each episode executes actual8DiT, decode RGB and compute loss, not cached reward lookup
RL.teacher: reuse original F and R25 train reference; repeated seed deterministic environments; no semantic reward

closed_loop_verification.assertions: online common2step features; selected-action trajectory/RGB identical to corresponding frozen action

promotion: No automatic promotion based on oracle, training fit or reference metric. Cal mean surrogate and RGB no worse than best train-fixed action; semantic review and net latency still needed.
